alt: Three icons for the signs that would confirm a PC date: a Rockstar post, a store page, and a listed date.

data.title: What would confirm a PC date

cards.title: A Rockstar post
cards.body: Rockstar or Take-Two announces a PC version in their own channels.

cards.title: A store page
cards.body: A PC store listing goes live with the game's name on it.

cards.title: A listed date
cards.body: That announcement or listing includes a date we can check.

data.note: Until then, PC is not announced.
